product_name: Motorola Edge 60 Pro 5G (Pantone Sparkling Grape, 12GB RAM, 256GB Storage), Purple
description: 💎 Stunning Curved AMOLED Display – Immerse your customers in a vibrant 6.7″ FHD+ curved AMOLED screen with a silky 144 Hz refresh rate, Dolby Vision, and HDR10+ support—perfect for immersive gaming, binging, or creative work. ⚡ Ultra-Fast Performance with Dimensity 8350 – Powered by the cutting-edge 4 nm MediaTek Dimensity 8350 chipset paired with 12 GB RAM, enabling seamless multi‑tasking, smooth app launches, and effortless 5G connectivity for blazing-speed downloads and streaming. 📸 Pro-Level Camera System – Capture life in stunning detail with the 50 MP OIS triple rear setup (wide, ultrawide & macro) and a sharp 50 MP front camera, complete with autofocus—for crisp, high-res shots and pro-style portraits, day or night. 🔋 Massive Battery & Fast Charging – With a robust 6,000 mAh battery, your device powers through all-day usage. Plus, feature-rich 90 W wired charging and 15 W wireless charging ensure minimal downtime and maximum convenience. 💧 Rugged & Stylish Build – Wrapped in the premium Pantone Sparkling Grape finish, this sleek handset also offers IP68/IP69 water and dust resistance for worry-free handling. Enjoy peace of mind with premium aesthetics and durable protection.
